tool_args.rationale: The paid rows include a zero-contrast equal-input case that constrains k_eq, alongside both signs of input change at varied H. Fit gain, positive relaxation time, and equilibrium coefficient numerically to all rows; the prior failure was only a missing-y input error, so no additional probe is warranted.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five paid rows span opposing input steps, an equal-input contrast-zero case, and multiple horizons; this is adequate to fit the recalled three-parameter law without another measurement.
Auxiliary high-variance measurements do not resolve a stated ambiguity in this target law and are explicitly unnecessary.
It depends on x_now and H but cannot explain the observed opposing-step response and equal-input calibration as parsimoniously as normalized before/after contrast.
It omits the recalled equilibrium term and does not account for the equal-input nonzero output.
